# Base template and dj-init skill Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Add `dj init base <dir>`, which creates an empty npm, pnpm or uv project with a generated `AGENTS.md` and a passing test command, plus an Agent Skills `dj-init` skill and a `dj skill install|uninstall` command that links it into every agent's skills folder.

**Architecture:** The base template is generated by code in `src/commands/base/`, not cloned. A template with no `gitUrl` in the existing registry is a generated template, and `initAction` hands it to `baseInitAction`. All decisions (answers, target-folder checks, package-manager commands, `AGENTS.md` text) are pure functions; one action function runs them with `execFileSync` and the filesystem. The skill lives in `skills/dj-init/`, ships in the npm package, and `src/commands/skill.ts` copies it to `~/.dj/skills/` and symlinks it into each agent folder.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript (ESM), commander 12, @inquirer/prompts 7 (`input`, `select`, `confirm`), chalk 5, Vitest 2, tsup.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-base-template-and-skill-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Node 18 or newer; no new runtime dependencies.
- Follow the README architecture rules: `src/index.ts` only registers commands; each command exports pure functions, an action handler and a `Command`.
- Run external programs with `execFileSync(cmd, args, ...)`, never a shell string, so names and descriptions with spaces or quotes are passed as-is.
- Package managers: `npm`, `pnpm`, `uv`. Default `pnpm`.
- Fixed values: npm/pnpm use `--init-type module`; uv uses `--lib` and uv's default Python; license `MIT`; author from `git config user.name`, falling back to `DiamondJdev`.
- Exact Docker line: `TODO: This project will run in Docker; add a Dockerfile before shipping`
- `CLAUDE.md` content is exactly `@AGENTS.md` plus a newline.
- `--yes` never prompts and never deletes. `--force` deletes and recreates the target folder.
- Agent skill folders, in this order: `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`, `~/.cursor/skills`, `~/.gemini/skills`. Central copy: `~/.dj/skills/<skill>`.
- Commit messages: `<type>: <description>` with types feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci.

The working tree has uncommitted ASCII-art changes (`package.json`, `src/index.ts`, `src/commands/init.ts`, `src/utils/ascii.ts`, `ascii.txt`) that belong to the user and are unrelated to this plan. Ask the user to commit those changes on their own (or approve a separate `feat: print ascii art on help and init` commit) before starting, so this plan's commits contain only this plan's work.

## Review Focus

1. A folder name that isn't a valid package name (`My App`, `Foo_Bar`): the default name becomes a valid lowercase name (`my-app`, `foo_bar`); an explicit invalid `--name` is an error before anything is created. Pinned in Task 2.
2. The chosen package manager isn't installed (`spawnSync pnpm ENOENT`): the error says `pnpm is not installed or not on PATH`, not a raw stack trace. Pinned in Task 4.
3. An invalid `--pm yarn`: error listing `npm, pnpm, uv` before any folder is created. Pinned in Task 2.
4. `dj init base .` in a fresh macOS folder that only holds `.DS_Store`: treated as empty. `.DS_Store` is added to the spec's allowed list (my call). Pinned in Task 2.
5. Running `dj skill install` twice: the second run refreshes the copy and relinks without reporting its own links as conflicts. Pinned in Task 1.

- [ ] **Step 2: Run** `npx vitest run tests/skill.test.ts`. Expected: FAIL, `installSkills` is not exported.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.** Move `findPackageRoot` to `src/utils/package-root.ts` and export it. In `skill.ts`: each subfolder of `sourceSkillsDir` is a skill. Refresh the copy with `fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true })` then `fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true })`. For each agent dir, the agent root is its first path segment: if the root doesn't exist, add it to `skipped`; otherwise `mkdirSync` the skills dir, then use `lstatSync`: a symlink is unlinked and recreated with `fs.symlinkSync(dest, link, "dir")`, a real entry goes to `conflicts` with a yellow warning, a missing entry is created. Uninstall unlinks only symlinks whose `readlinkSync` target starts with `path.join(home, ".dj", "skills")`, then removes `~/.dj/skills/<skill>` for each removed skill.

### Task 2: Base answers and target-folder checks

**Files:**
- Create: `src/commands/base/answers.ts`
- Create: `src/commands/base/target-dir.ts`
- Test: `tests/base-answers.test.ts`, `tests/base-target-dir.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces:
  - `type PackageManager = "npm" | "pnpm" | "uv"`; `PACKAGE_MANAGERS: readonly PackageManager[]` = `["npm", "pnpm", "uv"]`
  - `interface BaseFlags { name?: string; description?: string; pm?: string; docker?: boolean; yes?: boolean; git?: boolean; force?: boolean }` (commander sets `git: false` for `--no-git`)
  - `interface BaseAnswers { name: string; description: string; pm: PackageManager; docker: boolean; git: boolean; author: string }`
  - `toPackageName(raw: string): string` (lowercase; runs of characters outside `[a-z0-9._-]` become `-`; trim leading/trailing `-`)
  - `isValidPackageName(name: string): boolean` (matches `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$/`, length ≤ 214)
  - `readGitAuthor(): string` (`execFileSync("git", ["config", "user.name"])`, trimmed; `"DiamondJdev"` on error or empty)
  - `resolveBaseAnswers(dir: string, flags: BaseFlags, author: string): Promise<BaseAnswers>`: a flag value skips its prompt; without `--yes`, missing values are prompted (`input` name with default `toPackageName(path.basename(path.resolve(dir)))`, `input` description with a non-empty validator, `select` pm with default `pnpm`, `confirm` "Will this project run in Docker?" default `false`); with `--yes`, missing values take defaults and a missing description throws `Missing --description (required with --yes)`. Throws `Invalid --pm 'yarn'. Use one of: npm, pnpm, uv` and `Invalid --name 'X'. Use lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'`. `git` is `flags.git !== false`.
  - `ALLOWED_EXISTING: readonly string[]` = `[".git", "README.md", ".gitignore", ".DS_Store"]`
  - `interface TargetState { exists: boolean; hasGit: boolean; hasGitignore: boolean }`
  - `inspectTargetDir(dir: string): TargetState`: throws `Directory '<dir>' is not empty: <comma-separated entries outside ALLOWED_EXISTING>`

### Task 3: Package-manager commands and generated files

**Files:**
- Create: `src/commands/base/package-manager.ts`
- Create: `src/commands/base/agents-md.ts`
- Test: `tests/base-package-manager.test.ts`, `tests/base-agents-md.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `BaseAnswers`, `PackageManager` from Task 2.
- Produces:
  - `interface Step { cmd: string; args: string[] }`
  - `packageManagerSteps(a: BaseAnswers): Step[]`, exactly:
    - pnpm: `pnpm init --init-type module`; `pnpm pkg set name=<name> description=<description> author=<author> license=MIT "scripts.test=vitest run"`; `pnpm add -D vitest`
    - npm: `npm init -y --init-type module --init-author-name <author> --init-license MIT`; `npm pkg set name=<name> description=<description> "scripts.test=vitest run"`; `npm install -D vitest`
    - uv: `uv init --lib --vcs none --name <name> --description <description> --author-from git .`; `uv add --dev pytest`. `uv init` has no flag for an explicit author, so uv projects take the author from git config only; when git has no `user.name` the `authors` field is left empty instead of `DiamondJdev`. This is a known limit; don't patch `pyproject.toml` for it.
  - `interface PmCommands { install: string; test: string; singleTest: string }`; `pmCommands(pm: PackageManager): PmCommands`:
    - pnpm: `pnpm install`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm vitest run tests/example.test.ts`
    - npm: `npm install`, `npm test`, `npx vitest run tests/example.test.ts`
    - uv: `uv sync`, `uv run pytest`, `uv run pytest tests/test_example.py`
  - `exampleTest(pm: PackageManager): { path: string; content: string }`: npm/pnpm `tests/example.test.ts` (a Vitest `1 + 1 === 2` test importing `expect, test` from `vitest`); uv `tests/test_example.py` (`def test_example(): assert 1 + 1 == 2`).
  - `gitignoreFor(pm: PackageManager): string`: npm/pnpm `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `coverage/`, `.env`, `.DS_Store`; uv `.venv/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`, `.pytest_cache/`, `dist/`, `.env`, `.DS_Store`.
  - `DOCKER_TODO = "TODO: This project will run in Docker; add a Dockerfile before shipping"`; `CLAUDE_MD = "@AGENTS.md\n"`
  - `renderAgentsMd(a: BaseAnswers): string` with sections in this order: `# <name>`, overview (description, language TypeScript/Node for npm/pnpm or Python for uv, package manager), `DOCKER_TODO` on its own line under the overview only when `a.docker`, `## Commands` (a bash block with the three `pmCommands` lines and a comment on each), `## Boundaries` (ask first / never / always, as in the spec), `## Execution loop` (the six steps in the spec), then empty `## Architecture`, `## Environment variables` and `## Learned facts`, each with the line `Add entries here as the project grows.`

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `baseInitAction`.** Order: `validateTargetDir(dir)`; if `flags.force` and the folder exists, `rmSync` it; otherwise `inspectTargetDir(dir)`. Then `resolveBaseAnswers(dir, flags, readGitAuthor())`, `mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })`, run each `packageManagerSteps` step with `execFileSync(step.cmd, step.args, { cwd: dir, stdio: "inherit" })`, write `exampleTest`, create `docs/`, `src/`, `tests/` and put `.gitkeep` in any that are empty, write `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`, then if `answers.git`: write `.gitignore` unless it exists and run `git init` unless `.git` exists.
